content: The problem with the helper tool on this side is that there is a small edge near the top of the printer on this side. The tool must not be all the way up but rather rest against the edge there.
Got the other 3 by myself, recruited my partner to do the screw driving while I watched and held from the inside
This was probably the hardest one to get in and positioned correctly. I had to use double sided tape on my finger to hold the nut in place as the template would not line up either side.
